changelog:
* **fix: resolve Compose API compile errors** (542d016)
  - Use ui.layout.onSizeChanged instead of missing foundation.layout one.
  - Drop invalid ui.unit.toDp import; toDp resolves inside Density scope.
  - Replace padding(horizontal, bottom) with start/end/bottom named args.
* **style: flush updater scrollbar to screen right edge** (b8f4bd9)
  - Remove the 24dp horizontal padding from the updater content box so the scrollbar track spans full screen width.
  - Keep the content inset by moving the horizontal padding onto the four scrollable columns.
  - Add end padding to the floating Check again, Cancel, and Install buttons so they stay clear of the edge.
* **fix: keep quantity picker sheet compact** (f455716)
  - Bound the scrollbar canvas height to the measured sheet content height so the internal fillMaxHeight can no longer stretch the sheet to full screen.
  - Keep the end alignment on the scrollbar and trim the column top padding.
* **feat: warn before clearing quantity in picker** (b7bfa06)
  - Show the same Unsaved Changes dialog when the Clear button is
    tapped with a pending quantity, instead of clearing silently.
  - Track the discard trigger (Close vs Clear) with a DiscardTrigger
    enum so the dialog adapts: Clear flow says "Clearing will discard
    your changes" with a Clear button; Close flow keeps the existing
    "Closing now will discard your changes" / Close wording.
  - Confirm on the Clear flow resets the pending quantity instead of
    dismissing the sheet; empty pending state clears without a dialog.
* **fix: rename discard dialog button to Close** (1899e71)
  - Rename the Unsaved Changes dialog confirm button from
    "Discard & close" to "Close" in the quantity picker.
  - Drop the trailing full stop from "Closing now will discard
    your changes."
* **fix: naturalize Bangla text and render colons properly** (4f34597)
  - Rewrite stiff Bangla strings app-wide to everyday spoken Bangla.
  - Replace robotic phrasing: সেটআপ→সেট, প্রয়োগ→সেট, সুপারিশকৃত→সেরা পছন্দ,
    ভার্সেটাইল→বহুমুখী, উপলব্ধ→নতুন, পূর্বাবস্থায় আনুন→ফিরিয়ে আনুন,
    শিটের নাম পরিবর্তন→শিটের নাম বদলান, প্রস্তুতকৃত→থেকে তৈরি, ধরণ→ধরন.
  - Add util/BanglaTextSanitizer to convert colon-usage "ঃ" (typed by Bangla
    IMEs) into a real ":" while preserving in-word visarga (দুঃখ, নিঃশব্দ).
  - Apply the sanitizer to remarks on input, display, changelog, and all
    report exports (PDF/TXT/CSV) so colons never render as bisorgo.
  - Add BanglaTextSanitizerTest and extend CsvReportGeneratorTest with a
    sanitized-remark assertion.
  - Update the README settled-terms table and document the colon rule.
